| $y$ | $1$ | $2$ | $4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, 3)$ | $\dfrac{1}{3}$ | $\dfrac{1}{6}$ | $\dfrac{1}{2}$ |

Suppose $X$ and $Y$ are discrete random variables. Find $\textrm{Var}\big[Y \,|\, X=3\big]$ given that the conditional probability mass function $f_{Y|X}(y \,|\, 3)$ is shown in the table above and the corresponding conditional expected value is $\mu_{Y|3} = \dfrac{8}{3}.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional variance of $Y$ given $X=x$ is defined by

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=x] & =\text{E}[(Y-{\mu }_{Y|x})^{2}\,|\,X=x] \\  & =\text{E}[{Y}^{2}\,|\,X=x]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2} \\  & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,x)]-{\mu }_{Y|x}^{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[Y\,|\,X=3] & =[{\sum }_{y}{y}^{2}\,{f}_{Y|X}(y\,|\,3)]-{\mu }_{Y|3}^{2} \\  & =[(1)^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{3}+(2)^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{6}+(4)^{2}\cdot \frac{1}{2}]-{(\frac{8}{3})}^{2} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}+\frac{2}{3}+8-\frac{64}{9} \\  & =\frac{17}{9}.\end{aligned}
$$
